mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM faq WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO faq (category, question, answer, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{category}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{sortOrder}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE faq SET category = #{category}, question = #{question}, answer = #{answer}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE faq_id = #{faqId}
